overview.title: What is Amagi Life?
overview.text: Amagi Life is a regenerative village on Koh Phangan, Thailand for families, entrepreneurs, and creators building long-term community with shared ownership. The name Amagi comes from the first recorded word for freedom in ancient Sumer, roughly meaning "return to the mother." The village combines eco-conscious living with shared land stewardship and a community economy that rewards contribution over extraction.

overview.title: Who joins Amagi Life?
overview.text: Amagi Life attracts remote workers, location-independent entrepreneurs, artists, practitioners, and families who want stable long-term living outside the conventional property market. The community explicitly seeks early adopters: people who are self-directed, emotionally mature, and comfortable helping build something that is still taking shape. Villagers, investors, and partner organizations are all recognized pathways into the community.

history.text:
Amagi Life was founded in 2024 on Koh Phangan, Thailand by a team including Ofer Rotem, a blockchain investor and real estate developer with over 17 years of experience and more than 100 homes built on the island, and Geir Windsvoll, a serial entrepreneur who has lived on Koh Phangan for 17 years. The founding team set out to prototype a new kind of village where residents earn co-ownership through contribution rather than capital alone.

The project's first site is Hidden Valley, a secluded location in the hills above Ban Tai. In January 2025 the team launched the [Amagi Village Podcast](https://open.spotify.com/show/6KGJfBnSkoP2aPlh1vPmpT) on Spotify and YouTube to document the community's development in real time. By January 2026, nine residents were living across eleven available homes, with the team focused on reaching its first 20 to 30 residents.

location:
Amagi Life's first village occupies Hidden Valley, a secluded site in the hills above Ban Tai on Koh Phangan, approximately five minutes from the Ban Tai town centre. The setting pairs natural surroundings with straightforward access to island services and infrastructure.

Si Ri Panya International School - a Cambridge-accredited British school serving early years through secondary, taught in English and licensed by the Thai Ministry of Education - is five minutes from the village and provides bus transport to and from the community.

Koh Phangan is a Thai island in the Gulf of Thailand known for its beaches, jungle interior, and growing base of long-term residents. The island has direct ferry connections to the mainland and to Koh Samui, which has an international airport.
duration: Amagi Life is designed for long-term living rather than fixed-length cohorts or short visits. Residents join either as Residents, moving into an existing home, or as Builders, who commission a custom home through the in-house construction team. No minimum stay is publicly stated, but the community's equity model - where co-ownership grows through ongoing participation - is structured to reward residents who stay and contribute over time.
pricing:
Amagi Life uses a rent-reduction model tied to community participation. Three tiers are available:

- Full Value: live rent-free while earning village equity through active contribution
- Half Payment: 50% rent reduction with ongoing equity accumulation
- Standard Rate: normal rent with equity earned over time

Rent rates are set by community governance and vary by home. For residents who want to build rather than rent, land-plus-build packages start from approximately 60,000 baht. Specific terms are discussed during a 1:1 alignment call with the team. Contact join@amagi.life to start the conversation.
amenities: Long-term rental homes in a secluded hidden valley setting
Eco-village living with fresh air and nature access
Community events and facilitated pod sessions
In-house construction team for custom home builds (100+ homes built on Koh Phangan)
Co-ownership equity that grows through village contribution
5-minute access to Si Ri Panya Cambridge-accredited International School
Telegram community group for residents and prospective members
1:1 onboarding and alignment support from the founding team

howToEnter.text: The joining process starts with an [application form](https://amagi.life/join) where you describe your engagement type (Villager, Investor, or Partner) and your motivation for joining. The team then schedules a 1:1 alignment call to explore fit and next steps. Optional pod sessions - three facilitated meetings totaling six hours - cover presence, deep listening, and co-creation. After alignment, the team works with you on location selection and, if you plan to build, home design. Reach out to join@amagi.life to begin.

faqs.question: What does the name Amagi mean?
faqs.answer: Amagi is the first recorded word for freedom in human history, originating in ancient Sumer. It roughly translates to "return to the mother" or "return to freedom."

faqs.question: Where is Amagi Life located?
faqs.answer: Amagi Life is on Koh Phangan, Thailand. The first village is Hidden Valley, a secluded site in the hills above Ban Tai, about five minutes from the Ban Tai town centre.

faqs.question: Is Amagi Life family-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes. The community explicitly markets to families and is designed with education and a natural lifestyle in mind. Si Ri Panya International School - a Cambridge-accredited British school - is five minutes from the village and provides bus transport. The school offers outdoor learning, arts, sports, and cultural programs for early years through secondary.

faqs.question: How does the shared equity model work?
faqs.answer: Residents earn co-ownership in the village over time through active contribution. Equity is allocated through quarterly community voting based on tangible contributions. The model is designed to be portable across participating Amagi villages.

faqs.question: How do I apply to Amagi Life?
faqs.answer: Fill out the application form at [amagi.life/join](https://amagi.life/join) describing your engagement type and motivation. The team will schedule a 1:1 alignment call to discuss your goals and fit.

faqs.question: What housing options are available at Amagi Life?
faqs.answer: You can move into an existing rental home or commission a custom build through Amagi's in-house construction team, which has completed over 100 homes on Koh Phangan. Land-plus-build packages start from approximately 60,000 baht.

faqs.question: Are there good schools near Amagi Life?
faqs.answer: Yes. Si Ri Panya International School, a Cambridge-accredited British school serving early years through secondary, is five minutes from Hidden Valley. It is taught in English, licensed by the Thai Ministry of Education, and offers bus transport to and from the village.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to live at Amagi Life?
faqs.answer: Costs depend on your participation level. The rent-reduction model has three options: rent-free living (full community contribution), a 50% rent discount (regular participation), or standard rent with equity earned over time. Specific rates are set by community governance and discussed in your alignment call. Land-plus-build packages start from approximately 60,000 baht.

faqs.question: Who founded Amagi Life?
faqs.answer: The core founding team includes Ofer Rotem (blockchain investor and real estate developer with 17+ years and 100+ homes built on Koh Phangan), Geir Windsvoll (17-year Koh Phangan resident and serial entrepreneur), Dora Ho (venture builder and Stanford GSB alumna), and Mikkel Fishman (former CEO with systems and data infrastructure background). The full team and supporting cast are listed on the [Amagi team page](https://amagi.life/team).

faqs.question: Is there a minimum stay requirement?
faqs.answer: No fixed minimum stay is stated publicly. Amagi Life is designed for long-term living, and the equity model rewards contribution over time, so the community is better suited to residents planning to stay at least several months.

faqs.question: Does Amagi Life have a podcast?
faqs.answer: Yes. The [Amagi Village Podcast](https://open.spotify.com/show/6KGJfBnSkoP2aPlh1vPmpT) documents the real-time development of the community through conversations with innovators, community builders, and residents. It launched in January 2025 and is available on Spotify and YouTube.

faqs.question: Who are some notable advisors and investors in Amagi Life?
faqs.answer: Balaji Srinivasan, co-founder of Counsyl, former Coinbase CTO, and author of The Network State, is listed as an investor and advisor. Patri Friedman, founder of Pronomos Capital and the Seasteading Institute, is also an advisor. The complete list of investors, advisors, and partners is on the [Amagi team page](https://amagi.life/team).
